field_principles.budget_matcher_tolerance: Defines how tightly AR FLOPs are equalized to EBT FLOPs.
field_principles.flop_model_description: A transparent documented FLOP model makes matched compute auditable rather than hand-wavy.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal prefix; this is a build+test task, terminal on tests passing.
field_principles.inference_substrate: aggregation_from_upstream_artifacts because this builds an instrument and runs no live model.
field_principles.unit_tests_added: Names the test file; tests must run and assert.
field_principles.unit_tests_passed: Honest pass count; a failing harness cannot judge P0.1.

flop_model_description: FLOP model: total inference FLOPs = parameter_count * sequence_tokens * forward_passes. sequence_tokens = prompt_tokens + generated_tokens. EBT forward_passes = 1 initial sequence pass + K energy-descent passes; AR best-of-M forward_passes = M independent generation passes. The model omits attention-cache and hardware constants so matched-compute comparisons are symmetric and auditable.
inference_substrate: aggregation_from_upstream_artifacts (principle: builds an instrument, runs no live model).
